en: to surround somebody/something with a fence
ex: The small grass patch was fenced in.
小草丛被围起来。

en: to divide one area from another with a fence
ex: One end of the yard had been fenced off for the chickens.
院子的一头用栅栏隔开养鸡。

en: an attempt to improve relations between two people or groups and to try to find a solution when they disagree
a person who takes part in the sport of fencing

zh: 栅栏；篱笆；围栏；筑栅栏用的材料
en: the sport of fighting with long thin swords
ex: The factory is surrounded by electric fencing.
工厂有电网围着。

en: to take care of yourself without help from anyone else
ex: His parents agreed to pay the rent for his apartment but otherwise left him to fend for himself.
他的父母同意替他付房租，其他的则让他自己解决。

en: to defend or protect yourself from something/somebody that is attacking you
ex: The police officer fended off the blows with his riot shield.
那名警察用防暴盾牌抵挡攻击。

zh: 护舷材（悬挂在船舷的轮胎、绳子等，起防碰损作用）
en: a part of a car that is above a wheel

zh: 不严重的撞车事故；轻微车祸
en: a car accident in which there is not a lot of damage
ex: I had a fender bender on my first day.
我第一天就出了个小事故。

en: a Chinese system for deciding the right position for a building and for placing objects inside a building in order to make people feel comfortable and happy

zh: 芬尼运动成员（19 世纪 50 年代在美国和爱尔兰成立组织，致力于争取爱尔兰脱离英国统治）
（尤用于北爱尔兰）芬尼亚人（对天主教徒的蔑称）
en: a member of an organization formed in the 1850s in the US and Ireland in order to end British rule in Ireland
an area of low, flat, wet land in the east of England

zh: 茴香（茎作蔬菜，籽和叶亦用于烹调）
en: a vegetable that has a thick round stem with a strong taste. The seeds and leaves are also used in cooking.

zh: 葫芦巴（种子用于南亚食物调味）
en: a plant with hard yellow-brown seeds that are used in South Asian cooking as a spice
